name: z-image-comparison-v1
purpose: 任务1：FLUX klein FP8(4步) 对 Z-Image Turbo INT8/BF16文本(8步)，完全同题/尺寸/seed；14题×2seed×2模型=56张，无自动重抽。沿用原生正常运行参数，不将步数强制拉平。
decision_before_results: 低密度文字明显更好且视觉不差则Z为文生图默认、FLUX保留编辑
各有胜负则分用途保留
review_units: 逐字准确字符串数/指定总出现次数；图示另外核对精确节点与边，不把文字分当拓扑分；视觉逐张可用/不可用及理由

cases.prompt: A flat vector technical figure for a conference paper on a plain white background. No gradients, no shadows, no 3D, no icons, no photographs, no decorative illustration. Thin dark-gray strokes, very light gray fills, black sans-serif labels, even spacing, everything aligned to a clean grid. Centered title "Figure 1: Retrieval Pipeline" in regular weight. Exactly nine separate rounded rectangles labelled: "Query", "Encoder", "Index", "Retriever", "Reranker", "Context", "Generator", "Response", "Cache". Main row left to right: Query, Encoder, Retriever, Reranker, Context, Generator, Response. Index sits below Encoder. Cache sits above Encoder. A thin dashed rectangle encloses Index together with the small label "Offline index". Exactly nine thin arrows: Query→Encoder, Encoder→Retriever, Index→Retriever, Retriever→Reranker, Reranker→Context, Context→Generator, Generator→Response, Response→Cache, Cache→Encoder. No other shapes, arrows, legends or text.
cases.label: p1-paper-retrieval-figure
checks: 逐字计分，按指定出现次数计数
图示核对全部节点及有向边，重复或合并节点不通过
原图验收，不修字、不改线
